description: Read a cell range (A1 notation, e.g. 'Sheet1!A1:C10') from a spreadsheet as a 2D grid of values. Defaults to a 500-row effective limit to avoid an unbounded grid landing in context -- Sheets' values.get has no server-side size parameter, so this is enforced AFTER the fetch: a range returning more rows than the effective limit is refused loud (gsuite.result_too_large), never silently truncated, and the underlying vendor call itself is NOT narrowed by this limit -- request a smaller A1 range if the goal is a smaller call. To raise the limit, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 1000) -- both are required together, and a row_limit above the cap is refused rather than silently clamped. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Read cell values out of an existing Google Sheets spreadsheet by spreadsheet id and A1-notation range, such as a specific block or a bare tab name for a whole tab. Returns a grid of row values, capped at a 500-row effective limit -- a larger returned grid fails loud (gsuite.result_too_large) rather than truncating; raise the limit via acknowledge_default_limit_override + row_limit (up to 1000).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with a values 2D grid (list of row lists), bounded by the effective row limit.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the shape of the data (rows/columns) and show a few sample rows. Cell contents may be sensitive corporate data — treat as moderately sensitive.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read a cell range from a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id or range, or the override/row_limit pair was only half-given. gsuite.result_too_large: the range returned more rows than the effective limit (default 500, or the acknowledged override up to 1000) -- never silently truncated. gsuite.not_found: the spreadsheet id or range's sheet name does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply both id and an A1-notation range, and pass acknowledge_default_limit_override + row_limit together if overriding. gsuite.result_too_large: narrow the requested range, or pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true with an explicit row_limit (up to 1000). gsuite.not_found: verify the spreadsheet id and sheet/tab name. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
